text.description: Answer text. For choice-based requests use `yes` or `no`; `dontknow` is also accepted for `yes-no-dontknow`. Required for choice-based requests and `freetext`. For `fileupload`, provide non-empty text, at least one document, or both.

BusinessDebtorWriteRequest.description: Debtor who incurred the obligation in a business capacity. Supply exactly one of person (sole proprietors) or organization. Unknown and read-only request fields are rejected with a validation error instead of being silently ignored.

acting_as.description: The debtor incurred the obligation in a business capacity.

addresses.description: Postal addresses. A debtor can be created without addresses, but at least one complete address is required before an order can be finalized. A non-empty list must have exactly one primary address. Maximum 5 entries.

bank_accounts.description: Known bank accounts belonging to the debtor. Maximum 10 entries.

communication_channels.description: Email addresses and telephone numbers for the debtor. Maximum 10 entries.

events.description: Contextual events supplied when creating the debtor.

legal_form.description: Optional permanent code from GET /v2/legal-forms/; omit it or supply null or an empty string when unknown. Consumers cannot supply a code. The catalog group determines whether person or organization is required.

legal_representatives.description: People or organizations legally representing the debtor. Maximum 10 entries. Representative nesting is limited to two levels, with at most 10 second-level representatives per first-level representative.

metadata.description: Metadata supplied when creating the debtor; duplicate types are allowed.

organization.description: Organization identity, required for business legal forms outside the privatperson and einzelkaufmann groups, or when no legal form is supplied. Supply name; person must be absent or null. Consumers cannot use this field.

person.description: Natural-person identity, required for consumers and business legal forms in the privatperson or einzelkaufmann group. Also permitted for businesses without a legal form. Supply first_name and last_name; salutation is optional. Organization must be absent or null.

your_reference.description: Your reference for this debtor. Blank is stored as null.

auto_disabled.description: `true` when the endpoint was disabled automatically after reaching `max_consecutive_failures`; re-enable it with `enabled: true` once the destination is fixed. Auto-disabled endpoints do not count toward the endpoint limit.

consecutive_failures.description: Consecutive deliveries that reached terminal failure. Individual retry attempts do not increment this counter; a successful delivery resets it.

contract_version.description:
Payload/signature contract of this endpoint. Endpoints created via this API are always `v2`; `v1` marks a legacy subscription that still receives v1 payloads and must be recreated to migrate.

* `v1` - Legacy v1
* `v2` - Version 2

created_at.description: Time at which the webhook subscription was created.

description.description: Optional single-line label for this webhook.

enabled.description: Whether deliveries are attempted. Re-enabling an endpoint resets its consecutive failure counter. Auto-disabled endpoints do not count toward the endpoint limit, so re-enabling one requires a free slot; otherwise the request returns 409 webhook_limit_reached.

events.description: Current public event subscriptions for this endpoint. `["*"]` subscribes to all public events; otherwise the list contains the subscribed event types.

id.description: Stable identifier for this resource.

last_failure_at.description: Time of the most recent terminal delivery failure since the last successful delivery; null after a successful delivery or when no failure has been recorded.

max_consecutive_failures.description: Automatically disables the endpoint when this many consecutive deliveries reach terminal failure. Retry attempts within one delivery do not each count. Raising it above the failure count of an automatically disabled endpoint makes that endpoint count toward the endpoint limit again and requires a free slot.

secret_key.description: Signing secret shown once on creation or rotation. Store it to verify webhook signatures; list, retrieve, and idempotent replay responses omit it.

updated_at.description: Time at which the webhook subscription was last updated.

url.description: Publicly reachable HTTPS URL for webhook notifications. Must be unique among this company’s v2 endpoints; duplicate checks normalize the scheme, host, and default port.

ClaimLegalBasisWriteRequest.description:
Writable singular legal basis.

Every key is optional: an absent key keeps the company default (create)
or the stored value (PATCH); a supplied value — including `null` for
`description` — is persisted as sent.

claim_type_code.description: Public claim code. H17 (commercial rent) and H19 (residential rent) are valid only in rental orders and cannot be mixed in one order. Receivable enforcement costs in a titled order derive K014; do not supply a code for them. For other receivables, omission on creation or an empty string uses the company default when configured; omission on PATCH preserves the current code. See [legal basis codes](https://docs.paywise.de/api-docs/case-management-api/concepts/claims#legal-basis-codes) for the full code-to-meaning table.

contract_date.description: Date the underlying contract was concluded. For H17/H19 rent it is derived from the rental agreement and a supplied value must match. For other receivables it cannot follow document_date; when omitted during creation it defaults to document_date.

description.description: Terms or circumstances establishing the principal claim. Omission during creation, null, or an empty string uses the company default when configured; an omitted PATCH property keeps its current value. Maximum 2000 characters.

InvoiceOrder.description:
An invoice order contains receivable claims and exposes `starting_approach` and `creditor_obligation_fulfilled`.

Read representation of an order.

`status` is derived from the order's submission and review progress;
`mandate` names the
created mandate once the order is accepted; `merged_into` names the
surviving order when this order was merged away during review.

additional_debtors.description: Inline summaries of the additional debtors. Retrieve each debtor's full details with GET /v2/debtors/{id}/ using its id. Replace membership through PATCH /v2/orders/{id}/ while the order is a draft. API submissions are limited to 10 additional debtors.

claims.description: Receivable claims belonging to this order, including their itemized charges and documents. Titled claims are accepted only in titled orders. API submissions are limited to 50 claims per order.

confirmation_email.description: Address receiving the order-entry confirmation, when requested.

created_at.description: Time at which the order was created.

creditor_obligation_fulfilled.description: Whether you fully performed your obligation to the debtor.

debtor.description: Inline summary of the primary debtor. Retrieve full details with GET /v2/debtors/{id}/ using its id.

expires_at.description: Time at which this API-created draft expires: updated_at plus 90 days, refreshed by every successful draft change. Once it has passed, the order reads expired and every change answers 409 order_expired until the daily cleanup deletes it. Null once the order is finalized and for orders created in the portal.

id.description: Stable identifier of this order.

mandate.description: Accepted case created from this order, when available.

merged_into.description: Surviving order when this order was merged during review.

rejection.description: Why paywise declined the order: reason, time, notified recipients, and the standard reason's key. Null unless status is rejected.

starting_approach.description: Initial collection route: extrajudicial starts out of court; judicial starts by applying for a payment order (Mahnbescheid). Null while this decision is unset.

status.description: Order lifecycle state: draft is editable; submitted awaits processing; awaiting_client_response requires client input; accepted has entered case processing; rejected was declined; withdrawn was cancelled by the client; expired passed its draft deadline and accepts no further changes (409 order_expired) until the daily cleanup deletes it; merged points to the surviving order in merged_into.

totals.description: Financial totals calculated across the order's claims.

updated_at.description: Time at which the order was last updated.

InvoiceOrder.title: Invoice order

PatchedClaimUpdateRequest.description:
Partial update of a claim while its order is a draft.

One flat schema: a claim's type is immutable, so `type` is not a
writable field here and title ownership changes only through the
claim-owned `enforceable-title` route.

additional_charges.description: Itemized incidental charges for a receivable claim, such as reminder or bank fees. This array replaces all existing charges; [] clears them and omission preserves them. Maximum 50 entries per claim.

delay_date.description: Payment-default date for a receivable claim. For H17/H19 rent, an explicit date overrides the derived day after due_date and null restores derivation. For other receivables, null clears it; changing document_date, due_date, or reminders without supplying delay_date recalculates it. An explicit date must follow the applicable due or reminder date.

dispute_reason.description: Debtor's stated reason for disputing the claim. The resulting disputed claim must have a non-blank reason; an existing reason satisfies this requirement when omitted from PATCH. Setting is_disputed to false clears the existing reason unless you supply this field, which must then be empty or null.

document_date.description: Date of the invoice, contract, or other claim document. For H17/H19 rent, supply the first day of the rental month; only one rental claim per calendar month is allowed. Only valid for receivable claims. Required and cannot be in the future at finalization.

document_reference.description: Invoice, contract, or other source-document number.

due_date.description: Date on which a receivable claim became due. For H17/H19 rent, an explicit date overrides the agreement rule, null restores derivation, and omission preserves the current date or its existing derivation. For other receivables it cannot precede document_date.

is_disputed.description: Whether the debtor disputes the claim. Setting false also clears the existing dispute_reason unless you supply that field explicitly.

items.description: Invoice or contract lines for a receivable claim. This array replaces all existing lines; [] clears them and omission preserves them. Supply principal_amount separately when the principal changes. Maximum 100 entries per claim.

legal_basis.description: Contract or obligation establishing a receivable claim. Supplied properties update the existing legal basis; omitted properties stay unchanged. Not valid on titled claims or on receivable enforcement costs in titled orders, which always use K014.

principal_amount.description: Replacement principal amount including VAT, before charges and payments. Only valid for receivable claims; titled claims use their enforceable-title amount. Changing items does not update this amount. The principal must be positive before finalization.

reminders.description: Payment reminders for a receivable claim, in chronological order starting no earlier than its due date (or document date when due_date is absent). This array replaces all reminders; [] clears them and omission preserves them. Retain existing entries with their id. Maximum 50 entries per claim.

subject_matter.description: Goods, services, or other obligation underlying the claim. Before finalization, a receivable claim must have non-blank subject_matter or at least one claim document. Maximum 2000 characters.

your_reference.description: Your reference for this claim.

PatchedDebtorWriteRequest.description: Metadata and events are create-and-read only.

acting_as.description: Whether the debtor incurred the obligation as a consumer or in a business capacity. When changing it, update person, organization, and legal_form together to form a valid identity.

addresses.description: Postal addresses for the debtor. Supplied arrays replace the entire collection; [] clears it and omission leaves it unchanged. Include an existing child id to retain that entry. A non-empty list must have exactly one primary address; an order requires at least one complete address before finalization. Maximum 5 entries.

bank_accounts.description: Known bank accounts for the debtor. Supplied arrays replace the entire collection; [] clears it and omission leaves it unchanged. Include an existing child id to retain that entry. Duplicate IBANs are rejected. Maximum 10 entries.

communication_channels.description: Email addresses and telephone numbers for the debtor. Supplied arrays replace the entire collection; [] clears it and omission leaves it unchanged. Include an existing child id to retain that entry. Duplicate type/value pairs are rejected. Maximum 10 entries.

legal_form.description: Optional permanent code from GET /v2/legal-forms/. Null or an empty string clears it; consumers cannot supply a code. A supplied catalog group determines the permitted identity. Omission preserves the current value.

legal_representatives.description: Legal representatives for the debtor. Supplied arrays replace the entire collection; [] clears it and omission leaves it unchanged. Include an existing child id to retain that entry. Representative nesting is limited to two levels. Maximum 10 entries.

organization.description: Organization identity for business legal forms outside the privatperson and einzelkaufmann groups. Supplied properties update the current organization; omission leaves it unchanged and null removes it. The resulting debtor must retain a valid identity.

person.description: Natural-person identity for consumers and business legal forms in the privatperson or einzelkaufmann group. Supplied properties update the current person; omission leaves it unchanged and null removes it. The resulting debtor must retain a valid identity.

your_reference.description: Your reference for this debtor. Blank is stored as null.

PatchedEnforceableTitlePatchRequest.description: Update the supplied title metadata; omitted fields retain their values.

amount.description: Gross amount confirmed by the client and owned by the enforceable title. May be absent or null while drafting; must be positive before finalization.

file_number.description: Official file or reference number shown on the title. Required before finalization.

issued_on.description: Date on which the enforceable title was issued. Required before finalization.

issuing_authority.description: Court, notary, or other authority that issued the title. Required before finalization.

legally_binding_since.description: Optional date from which the title is legally binding; it cannot precede issued_on.

served_on.description: Optional date on which the title was served; it cannot precede issued_on.

title_type.description: Legal title category: enforcement_order = Vollstreckungsbescheid; default_judgment = Versäumnisurteil; final_judgment = Endurteil; acknowledgment_judgment = Anerkenntnisurteil; reservation_judgment = Vorbehaltsurteil; court_settlement = Gerichtlicher Vergleich; enforceable_notarial_deed = Vollstreckbare notarielle Urkunde; cost_assessment_order = Kostenfestsetzungsbeschluss; other = Sonstiger Titel. Required before finalization.

PatchedMessagePatchRequest.description: Update the message title, body, or both. Supply at least one field; omitted fields retain their values. Unknown fields are rejected.

body.description: Message content sent to paywise; supported HTML is sanitized and the content must not be empty after sanitization.

PatchedOrderDecisionPatchRequest.description: The order fields that stay editable while it is a draft.

additional_debtor_ids.description: Replace the order's additional-debtor membership with up to 10 existing debtor UUIDs from the active company. Omit to leave membership unchanged; [] unlinks all additional debtors without deleting their records. The primary debtor cannot also appear here, and duplicates are rejected. Available only while the order is a draft.

confirmation_email.description: Address that receives the order entry confirmation (Eingangsbestätigung) when the order is finalized. Set null to turn the confirmation email off again.

creditor_obligation_fulfilled.description: Whether you have fully performed your obligation to the debtor. For invoice and rental orders, supply true or false before finalization; null leaves the decision unset. Omit for titled orders.

debtor_id.description: Replace the primary debtor with an existing debtor in the selected company.

starting_approach.description: Initial route for invoice and rental orders: extrajudicial starts with out-of-court collection; judicial starts by applying for a payment order (Mahnbescheid). Required before finalization; omit for titled orders, where enforcement is implicit.

success_fee_confirmed.description: Only valid for titled orders. Confirmation of the titled-order success-fee arrangement; it must be true before finalization. See the [paywise General Terms and Conditions (AGB)](https://paywise.de/agb/) for the exact conditions for titled orders.

PatchedRentalAgreementWriteRequest.description: Unknown and read-only request fields are rejected with a validation error instead of being silently ignored.

contract_date.description: Date on which the rental contract was concluded; this is not the tenancy start or move-in date. Required before finalization. Updating it also updates the legal_basis.contract_date of H17/H19 claims in the order.

due_rule.description: Rule used to derive H17/H19 rental due dates. Omission preserves the current rule; null restores the default third German business day. Changes recalculate dates except claim-level dates explicitly overridden by the client.

monthly_rent.description: Total recurring Warmmiete, including ancillary-cost prepayments; it does not constrain an individual claim amount. May be absent or null while drafting; must be positive before finalization.

property_address.description: Complete address of the rented property, even when it matches the debtor address. Supply street, postal_code, city, and country; this creates a separate property address and does not reuse a debtor address id or primary flag. A complete property address is required before finalization.

PatchedWebhookRequest.description: A webhook subscription. The signing secret is never included; it is returned exactly once on creation or rotation.

description.description: Optional single-line label for this webhook.

enabled.description: Whether deliveries are attempted. Re-enabling an endpoint resets its consecutive failure counter. Auto-disabled endpoints do not count toward the endpoint limit, so re-enabling one requires a free slot; otherwise the request returns 409 webhook_limit_reached.

events.description: Replacement list of public event subscriptions. Use `["*"]` for all public events; the wildcard must be the only list entry. Omit to keep the endpoint’s current subscriptions.

max_consecutive_failures.description: Automatically disables the endpoint when this many consecutive deliveries reach terminal failure. Retry attempts within one delivery do not each count. Raising it above the failure count of an automatically disabled endpoint makes that endpoint count toward the endpoint limit again and requires a free slot.

url.description: Publicly reachable HTTPS URL for webhook notifications. Must be unique among this company’s v2 endpoints; duplicate checks normalize the scheme, host, and default port. A company can register at most 20 webhook endpoints. Enabled and manually disabled endpoints count toward this limit; automatically disabled endpoints do not, and re-enabling one requires a free slot. Exceeding the limit returns 409 webhook_limit_reached; delete an unused endpoint to free capacity.

value.description: Amount received, expressed with two decimal places. Exact decimal string; parse it with a decimal type, never a binary float.

ReceivableClaimCreateRequest.description: Create a receivable claim: the amount is stated on the claim itself.

additional_charges.description: Itemized incidental claims such as reminder or bank fees. Maximum 50 entries per claim.

delay_date.description: Date from which the debtor is considered in payment default. For H17/H19 rent, omission on creation derives the day after due_date, an explicit date overrides it, and null restores derivation. For other receivables, omission allows automatic calculation from available dates; null explicitly clears the date. An explicit date must follow the applicable due or reminder date.

dispute_reason.description: Debtor's stated reason for disputing the claim. Required and non-blank when is_disputed is true; must be empty or null when it is false.

document_date.description: Date of the invoice, contract, or other claim document. For H17/H19 rent, supply the first day of the rental month; only one rental claim per calendar month is allowed. Required and cannot be in the future at finalization.

document_reference.description: Invoice, contract, or other source-document number.

documents.description: Documents attached to this receivable claim. A command may contain at most 20 documents in total across all nested claims, titles, and rental agreements. The combined decoded document content across the command must not exceed 50 MiB; each file is limited to 10 MiB and each PDF to 100 pages. Exceeding a limit rejects the command with 400.

due_date.description: Date on which the principal became due. For H17/H19 rent, omission on creation derives it from the agreement; an explicit date overrides that rule and null restores derivation. For other receivables it cannot precede document_date.

events.description: Contextual events supplied when creating the claim.

is_disputed.description: Whether the debtor disputes the claim.

items.description: Optional invoice or contract lines supporting the principal claim. Supply principal_amount separately; these lines do not calculate it. Maximum 100 entries per claim.

legal_basis.description: Legal basis for a receivable claim; titled enforcement costs derive K014 and therefore omit this field.

metadata.description: Metadata supplied when creating the claim; duplicate types are allowed.

payments.description: Payments already received for this claim. Maximum 50 entries per claim during creation; report later payments through the payment endpoints.

principal_amount.description: Original principal amount including VAT, before charges and payments. Required even when items are supplied; line items do not calculate this value for you. The principal must be positive before finalization.

reminders.description: Payment reminders in chronological order. The first reminder cannot precede the claim due date, or document date when no due date is set; later reminders cannot precede an earlier reminder or its payment deadline. Maximum 50 entries per claim.

subject_matter.description: Goods, services, or other obligation underlying the claim. Before finalization, a receivable claim must have non-blank subject_matter or at least one claim document. Maximum 2000 characters.

your_reference.description: Your reference for this claim.

RentalOrder.description:
A rental order contains receivable claims and one `rental_agreement`, alongside `starting_approach` and `creditor_obligation_fulfilled`.

Read representation of an order.

`status` is derived from the order's submission and review progress;
`mandate` names the
created mandate once the order is accepted; `merged_into` names the
surviving order when this order was merged away during review.

additional_debtors.description: Inline summaries of the additional debtors. Retrieve each debtor's full details with GET /v2/debtors/{id}/ using its id. Replace membership through PATCH /v2/orders/{id}/ while the order is a draft. API submissions are limited to 10 additional debtors.

claims.description: Receivable claims belonging to this order, including their itemized charges and documents. Titled claims are accepted only in titled orders. API submissions are limited to 50 claims per order.

confirmation_email.description: Address receiving the order-entry confirmation, when requested.

created_at.description: Time at which the order was created.

creditor_obligation_fulfilled.description: Whether you fully performed your obligation to the debtor.

debtor.description: Inline summary of the primary debtor. Retrieve full details with GET /v2/debtors/{id}/ using its id.

expires_at.description: Time at which this API-created draft expires: updated_at plus 90 days, refreshed by every successful draft change. Once it has passed, the order reads expired and every change answers 409 order_expired until the daily cleanup deletes it. Null once the order is finalized and for orders created in the portal.

id.description: Stable identifier of this order.

mandate.description: Accepted case created from this order, when available.

merged_into.description: Surviving order when this order was merged during review.

rejection.description: Why paywise declined the order: reason, time, notified recipients, and the standard reason's key. Null unless status is rejected.

rental_agreement.description: Rental-agreement singleton owned by this order.

starting_approach.description: Initial collection route: extrajudicial starts out of court; judicial starts by applying for a payment order (Mahnbescheid). Null while this decision is unset.

status.description: Order lifecycle state: draft is editable; submitted awaits processing; awaiting_client_response requires client input; accepted has entered case processing; rejected was declined; withdrawn was cancelled by the client; expired passed its draft deadline and accepts no further changes (409 order_expired) until the daily cleanup deletes it; merged points to the surviving order in merged_into.

totals.description: Financial totals calculated across the order's claims.

updated_at.description: Time at which the order was last updated.

TitledOrder.description:
A titled order contains titled claims and may include receivable claims for enforcement costs. It exposes `success_fee_confirmed` and omits `starting_approach` and `creditor_obligation_fulfilled`; enforcement is implicit.

Read representation of an order.

`status` is derived from the order's submission and review progress;
`mandate` names the
created mandate once the order is accepted; `merged_into` names the
surviving order when this order was merged away during review.

Once it has passed, the order reads expired and every change answers 409 order_expired until the daily cleanup deletes it. Null once the order is finalized and for orders created in the portal.

get.description:
Claims addressed by their stable UUID and current relationships.

Read claims throughout their lifecycle using URLs that remain valid after
internal order moves. Standalone creation requires a draft `order_id`;
the relationship is read-only thereafter. Create, PATCH, and DELETE require
a draft order and otherwise return `409 claim_not_editable`. An expired
draft instead returns `409 order_expired`. Tenant-scoped by the
authenticated company.

parameters.description: Required when a Partner key calls the Case Management API; rejected for direct Case keys. Contains the entitled paywise company UUID.
parameters.name: X-On-Behalf-Of-Company

parameters.description: Opaque continuation cursor for incremental synchronization, taken from the `next` URL of a previous page. Only valid together with `updated_since`: with `updated_since` set the list is ordered by change time and then id and pages by this cursor instead of `offset`, so a row that changes while you page is returned again later instead of pushing another row out of the result. Rows changed less than 60 seconds ago are held back until they are settled; use the largest `updated_at` you received as the next `updated_since`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Exact match on the document reference (e.g. the invoice number), ignoring case and surrounding whitespace.
parameters.name: document_reference

parameters.description: Number of results to return (maximum 100).
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Zero-based result offset. Cannot be combined with `updated_since`; follow the `next` URL (`cursor`) instead.
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Filter claims by their parent order's UUID.
